assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: website feature illustration, single isolated transparent PNG, square 1024x1024.
Primary request: Draw the charming green walking Neurodiverse Guide book character shown in the supplied concept reference, as ONE complete standalone character. Make it production-ready to use alongside website text.

Input images: Image 1 is the SELECTED WEBSITE CONCEPT and controls the exact character design, drawing style and color. Re-create ONLY its middle green walking book character; do not reproduce the page, typography, layout, portrait, comic or other characters. Image 2 is a supporting SOURCE for the illustration on the book cover: use the support-group picture near the lower center, showing people gathered around and supporting one central person. Keep that recognizable composition on the cover.

Subject and style: Cheerful evergreen clothbound hardback book with lightly worn gold border details, cream paper pages, cream cartoon glove hands spread open in a welcoming gesture, short cream legs, oversized brown lace-up boots in a jaunty walking pose. The green book has no face; its cover illustration and open arms give it personality. The cover title MUST read exactly "Neurodiverse Guide" on two lines in white, clearly legible, above the colorful support-group picture. Preserve the friendly storybook ink outlines, warm hand-painted watercolor texture and slightly imperfect organic edges from Image 1. The cover should face mostly forward with a little three-quarter dimension, as in Image 1.
Composition/framing: Full character centered, including all fingers and boots, with generous transparent safe margins of 12-15 percent. Character silhouette comfortably fills about 72 percent of the square; arrange slightly wide rather than very tall, so it remains strong at a 300x240 desktop feature slot and a 190x180 mobile slot. A few very small golden joy marks by the raised hands are okay if separated cleanly. 
Scene/backdrop: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background. No opaque white or beige background, no checkerboard pattern baked into the image, no floor, no landscape, no grass, no background wash. A tiny soft transparent contact shadow under boots is optional.
Text (verbatim): "Neurodiverse Guide". No other text.
Constraints: One book character only. No UI. No title outside book. No surrounding webpage. Match the selected reference faithfully. Preserve clean alpha edges and crisp details at small size.

checks.visualReview: Whole book, hands, boots and cover picture visible; recognizably matches selected concept. The support-group illustration is a generated interpretation of the source image.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: tiny standalone botanical footer decoration for a personal website, transparent PNG, square composition.
Primary request: A small, restrained hand-painted sprig patch matching the illustrated footer plants in Image1, the selected personal-site design. Re-create only the little green botanical tuft with a couple of tiny golden-yellow flowers, as one isolated asset.
Reference: Image1 is the selected website concept. Use only its bottom-left/bottom-right botanical decoration for stylistic reference. Do not reproduce any page, text, buttons, characters, UI or other artwork.
Subject: A single modest cluster of slender soft sage and olive-green leaves, 3-4 shorter grassy blades and two delicate stems with tiny five-petal golden yellow flowers. Fine imperfect dark-green ink outlines and light watercolor washes, natural asymmetry. Charming, airy and subtle. No pot. No face.
Composition: One low, slightly wide patch occupying about 65percent of a square, centered with ample clear space around all edges. Designed to be readable as a quiet 150x80-pixel footer ornament. Very restrained pale translucent green dab of earth immediately beneath the leaves is okay. Do not make a full landscape, horizontal divider or repeating texture.
Background: Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha. No white background, no beige paper, no baked checkerboard. Entire background empty and transparent.
Constraints: No text, no UI, no arrows, no people, no animals, no borders, no frames, no extra objects. Match the refined friendly watercolor-and-ink style of Image1.
